meta.source: London Datastore: Conservation Areas (Planning Constraints Map)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3 (Planning Constraints Map). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector)
meta.method: walk-london-datastore.mjs harvest conservation-areas: download the newest matching resource (gpkg); read every feature; keep a feature whose geometry meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300; WGS84 -0.095, 51.474, 0.015, 51.522): a vertex inside, an edge crossing the box or the box inside a polygon. Whole geometries are kept (not cut at the box): whole_in_zone says whether all of it lies inside. in_cw: the geometry meets the Canary Wharf registry box -0.03, 51.498, -0.005, 51.51. Source attributes kept as published except fields matching e-?mail|phone|tel(ephone)?$|^tel|contact|^fax|mobile|website_contact|^owner_?name|person. uprn_suspect: a UPRN field that a spreadsheet rounded (an exponent, or 9+ digits ending in 5+ zeros); not a key (fault F22).
